answer: The canyon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The fable is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the vine.
